facts.summary: Sold legacy abuse-deterrent ADHD asset after trial missed threshold, for modest upfront payment · Clinical-stage · ADAIR in ADHD · not yet approved

evidence.summary: GRI Bio Enters into Asset Purchase Agreement with Aardvark Therapeutics, Inc. for the Sale of Legacy Asset, ADAIR
evidence.primary_endpoint_met: ADAIR has demonstrated abuse deterrent properties, but did not surmount the established threshold in its most recent clinical trial to support pursuing an FDA approval.
evidence.program_discontinued: Aardvark will assume responsibility for and endeavor to develop and commercialize the purchased assets.
